name: com.mineant.miohelper
description:
USEFUL PACKAGES (Recommend to install)
https://github.com/v0lt13/EditorAttributes.git

ABOUT
This package has scripts created by MioHelper that are useful for all projects

samples.description: A complete inventory system demo with items, UI, buying/getting items, and a test scene.
Example showing how to extend the DataPersistence system with custom game data.
Example abilities, triggers and conditions built on the AbilitySystem. Includes AE_ShootProjectile, which integrates the projectile system.
Self-bootstrapping projectile system demo (no scene assets): launches spread fans, shows the IProjectileHitHandler hit seam and the pool in action.
Self-bootstrapping demo of the TextFormat module: the @{key} / {C:}/{N:}/{L:} template grammar shown raw vs formatted. No scene assets needed.

Self-bootstrapping demo of the click + hover tooltip module: {L:} links in TMP text and hoverable panels open keyword-resolved tooltips with nested links, colors, and @{key} values. No scene assets needed.
